ValidationRule.description: This prevents users adding time cards for previous months if time has been reviewed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Milestones__r.Invoice_Status__c))) || NOT(ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE( Invoice_Status_from_Billing_Milestone__c ) ))) && OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Hours__c ), ISCHANGED( Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED( Billing_Milestones__c ), ISCHANGED( Assignment__c ), ISCHANGED( Description_of_Work__c )) && NOT( $Permission.Edit_TImecards_Once_Billing_Starts )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot enter time for this date as the time for this month has been reviewed/invoiced.
